{"consolidated_memory":"## Cache Miss Storm Incidents in build/bazel/BUILD.bazel

**Problem**: Cache miss storm in the build graph—targets that should have been cached are rebuilt despite no source change. Signal is a rebuild of targets that should have been cached. Stack is Starlark. Covering check is the remote cache hit rate check in CI.

**Six separate occasions fixed:**

**Occasion 1 [2026-01-12]**
- Trigger: tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it (PR #3668, branch fix/cache-miss-storm-1)
- Repro: build twice with no source change
- Result: reclaimed 99 GB of blob storage

**Occasion 2 [2026-03-31]**
- Trigger: two requests raced on the same key
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query (PR #4983, branch fix/cache-miss-storm-2)
- Repro: build twice with no source change
- Result: flaky test went from 70 failures per hundred runs to zero

**Occasion 3 [2026-04-15]**
- Trigger: records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call (PR #5920, branch fix/cache-miss-storm-3)
- Repro: build twice with no source change
- Result: throughput rose 19 percent, to 245 requests per second

**Occasion 4 [2026-04-20]**
- Trigger: input list came in empty
- Root cause: listener registered but never removed
- Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test (PR #6997, branch fix/cache-miss-storm-4)
- Repro: build twice with no source change
- Result: alert stayed quiet for 86 consecutive days

**Occasion 5 [2026-05-27]**
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: race in lazy initialisation
- Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock (PR #7260, branch fix/cache-miss-storm-5)
- Repro: build twice with no source change
- Result: error rate dropped from 7.5 percent to under 5 per ten thousand

**Occasion 6 [2026-06-17]**
- Trigger: payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: moved the arithmetic to integer minor units (PR #7780, branch fix/cache-miss-storm-6)
- Repro: build twice with no source change
- Result: backlog cleared 39 minutes after the deploy"}
